title: Breakable file (data/breakables/<id>.json, one kind per file)
description: Something in the world a blow cuts or breaks: tall grass, a clay pot, a fallen branch, an old stump (TECH_DESIGN §6, §28), and the overgrowth of the hero's land: weeds, a bush, a fallen log, an old stump (§30). Placed by the map baker's spawn markers; back on every visit unless it 'returns' daily or never.

id.description: Also the spawn marker's kind (GreyboxTiles.MARKER_KINDS, LAND_MARKER_KINDS).

breaks_on.description: The kinds of blow (Hit.kind) that break it; anything else does nothing. Wood (a branch, a stump, a log) says 'axe' and not 'sword' (icons-axe-bar plan, Q6): a blow of the axe counts as 1 + its 'fewer_blows' of the hits, and the sword only knocks on it ("It wants an axe.").

hits.description: The blows it takes: a fallen branch one, an old stump three (of the plain axe; a better axe's blow counts for more). Each blow before the last plays its sound and throws up a little of its burst.

returns.description: Left out, it is back on every visit. 'daily': broken, it stays broken until the next morning (the flag cut/<area>/<x>,<y> keeps the day). Wood says so. 'never': cleared, it is gone for good (GameState.clear_debris keeps its cell in the save's 'homestead'): the overgrowth of the hero's land says so, and it means that only there.

sound.description: A sound id (audio/sfx) played when it breaks.

frames.description: Frames of gameplay/art/breakables.png (Breakable.FRAMES): 'whole', and 'broken' (empty: nothing is left).

drops.description: Weighted table, like an enemy's: one entry is picked when it breaks.
